setup.title: Setup
setup.subtitle: Foundational steps to get SellerHill working for you.

order_amazon_cancelled.title: Amazon cancelled a purchase you already paid for
order_amazon_cancelled.description_one: {{count}} order was cancelled on the Amazon side. The eBay sale is still live and still owed to the buyer — re-order it or refund before eBay counts it as a defect.
order_amazon_cancelled.description_other: {{count}} orders were cancelled on the Amazon side. Those eBay sales are still live and still owed to the buyers — re-order them or refund before eBay counts them as defects.

order_fulfillment_blocked.title: Automatic purchase stopped before paying
order_fulfillment_blocked.description_one: {{count}} order was stopped by a safety check, so no money moved. Fix the reason below and it can go through.
order_fulfillment_blocked.description_other: {{count}} orders were stopped by a safety check, so no money moved. Fix the reasons below and they can go through.

order_purchase_unknown.title: Purchase not confirmed — check Amazon first
order_purchase_unknown.description_one: Orders whose Amazon purchase could not be confirmed: {{count}}. The order button was pressed but no confirmation came back, so the order may exist. Check Amazon and link it before anything is bought again.
order_purchase_unknown.description_other: Orders whose Amazon purchase could not be confirmed: {{count}}. The order button was pressed but no confirmation came back, so the order may exist. Check Amazon and link it before anything is bought again.

order_awaiting_purchase.title: Sold, but nobody has bought it on Amazon
order_awaiting_purchase.description_one: {{count}} order older than {{hours}} hours has no Amazon purchase and no automation running on it. It will not ship unless you buy it yourself.
order_awaiting_purchase.description_other: {{count}} orders older than {{hours}} hours have no Amazon purchase and no automation running on them. They will not ship unless you buy them yourself.

order_untracked.title: Sales from listings you do not track
order_untracked.description_one: {{count}} order in the last {{days}} days came from an eBay item that is not linked to a SellerHill listing, so its cost and profit can never be calculated. Import the listing to track future sales.
order_untracked.description_other: {{count}} orders in the last {{days}} days came from eBay items that are not linked to SellerHill listings, so their cost and profit can never be calculated. Import those listings to track future sales.

order_tracking_problem.title: Tracking conversion has a problem
order_tracking_problem.description_one: {{count}} shipped order has an open problem with the tracking provider. Until it is resolved, that order shows the original Amazon tracking number to your buyer instead of a converted one.
order_tracking_problem.description_other: {{count}} shipped orders have open problems with the tracking provider. Until they are resolved, those orders show the original Amazon tracking numbers to your buyers instead of converted ones.

order_tracking_conversion_held.title: Orders not marked shipped on eBay
order_tracking_conversion_held.description_one: {{count}} order shipped on Amazon over {{hours}} hours ago but has not been marked shipped on eBay, because its tracking number could not be converted. We never send the original Amazon tracking number to your buyer. Resolve the cause and the order ships automatically — until then it risks a late shipment defect.
order_tracking_conversion_held.description_other: {{count}} orders shipped on Amazon over {{hours}} hours ago but have not been marked shipped on eBay, because their tracking numbers could not be converted. We never send original Amazon tracking numbers to your buyers. Resolve the cause and they ship automatically — until then they risk late shipment defects.

order_cancelled_amazon_open.title: eBay cancelled a sale you already bought on Amazon
order_cancelled_amazon_open.description_one: {{count}} order was cancelled on eBay in the last {{days}} days, but the Amazon order placed for it is still open. Nobody is waiting for that item any more — cancel the Amazon order, or return the item if it has shipped.
order_cancelled_amazon_open.description_other: {{count}} orders were cancelled on eBay in the last {{days}} days, but the Amazon orders placed for them are still open. Nobody is waiting for those items any more — cancel the Amazon orders, or return the items if they have shipped.

order_late_to_ship.title: Orders past eBay's ship-by date
order_late_to_ship.description_one: {{count}} order has passed eBay's ship-by date and eBay still has no shipment for it. A late shipment counts against your seller account.
order_late_to_ship.description_other: {{count}} orders have passed eBay's ship-by date and eBay still has no shipment for them. Late shipments count against your seller account.

return_seller_action_due.title: Returns waiting for your response
return_seller_action_due.description_one: {{count}} return has a next step that eBay expects from you. Respond on eBay before the deadline shown on the Returns page.
return_seller_action_due.description_other: {{count}} returns have a next step that eBay expects from you. Respond on eBay before the deadlines shown on the Returns page.

ebay_account_disconnected.title: An eBay store lost its connection
ebay_account_disconnected.description_one: {{count}} store is no longer authorized. Order sync, repricing and publishing are stopped for it until you reconnect.
ebay_account_disconnected.description_other: {{count}} stores are no longer authorized. Order sync, repricing and publishing are stopped for them until you reconnect.

ebay_account_messaging_scope_missing.title: Reconnect a store to enable eBay messages
ebay_account_messaging_scope_missing.description_one: {{count}} store was connected before messaging was added. Reconnect it to read and answer eBay messages here.
ebay_account_messaging_scope_missing.description_other: {{count}} stores were connected before messaging was added. Reconnect them to read and answer eBay messages here.

amazon_account_needs_attention.title: An Amazon buyer account cannot sign in
amazon_account_needs_attention.description_one: {{count}} buyer account is failing sign-in, so nothing can be purchased through it.
amazon_account_needs_attention.description_other: {{count}} buyer accounts are failing sign-in, so nothing can be purchased through them.

listing_job_failures.title: Listings that could not be created
listing_job_failures.description_one: {{count}} listing failed in the last {{days}} days. The reason tells you whether it is fixable on your side.
listing_job_failures.description_other: {{count}} listings failed in the last {{days}} days. The reasons tell you which are fixable on your side.

listing_source_unavailable.title: Live listings whose Amazon product is unavailable or unreadable
listing_source_unavailable.description_one: {{count}} active listing points at an Amazon product that is unavailable or whose data could not be read. Check the product and end the listing if it is gone.
listing_source_unavailable.description_other: {{count}} active listings point at Amazon products that are unavailable or whose data could not be read. Check the products and end the listings that are gone.

listing_out_of_stock.title: Live listings at zero quantity
listing_out_of_stock.description_one: {{count}} active listing is showing on eBay with nothing to sell. It earns nothing until the source restocks.
listing_out_of_stock.description_other: {{count}} active listings are showing on eBay with nothing to sell. They earn nothing until the source restocks.

listing_drafts_pending.title: Drafts that were never published
listing_drafts_pending.description_one: {{count}} draft is prepared and costs you nothing — but it also sells nothing until it goes live.
listing_drafts_pending.description_other: {{count}} drafts are prepared and cost you nothing — but they also sell nothing until they go live.

plan_listing_quota.title: Active listing limit almost reached
plan_listing_quota.description: You are using {{used}} of {{limit}} listing slots. New listings are refused once the limit is hit; existing ones keep running.

plan_ao_quota.title: Monthly automatic order limit almost reached
plan_ao_quota.description: You have used {{used}} of {{limit}} automatic orders this month. Once it is reached, new orders must be purchased by hand until the month resets.

plan_past_due.title: Your last payment failed
plan_past_due.description: Update your payment method to keep automation running.

plan_trial_ending.title: Your trial is ending
plan_trial_ending.description_one: {{count}} day left. Choose a plan to keep your listings and automatic orders running.
plan_trial_ending.description_other: {{count}} days left. Choose a plan to keep your listings and automatic orders running.

setup_no_ebay_store.title: Connect your eBay store
setup_no_ebay_store.description: Nothing else in SellerHill can run without an eBay store connected — listings, orders and automation all depend on it. This is the one thing to do first.

setup_no_amazon_account.title: No Amazon buyer account yet
setup_no_amazon_account.description: You are selling, but there is no Amazon account to buy from — every order has to be purchased by hand. Adding one enables automatic fulfilment.

setup_no_store_settings.title: Store settings not configured yet
setup_no_store_settings.description: Your shipping origin and blacklist keywords are still unset. These are used to compute costs and to keep listings from publishing with blocked content.

setup_no_listing_settings_group.title: No listing settings group yet
setup_no_listing_settings_group.description: A listing settings group defines pricing, stock and repricing rules — every listing needs one, so you cannot create your first listing without it.

setup_auto_fulfill_off.title: Automatic purchasing is off
setup_auto_fulfill_off.description: Your Amazon accounts are connected but none is cleared to buy. Turn it on with a spend cap and new orders are purchased for you.

plan_conversion_quota.title: Monthly tracking conversion limit almost reached
plan_conversion_quota.description: You have used {{used}} of {{limit}} tracking conversions this month. Once it is reached, orders still ship and eBay still gets a tracking number — but it will be the original Amazon one, so buyers can see your supplier.

plan_suspended.title: Automation is suspended
plan_suspended.description: Your subscription is no longer active, so new listings, price and stock updates, automatic purchasing and tracking conversion have stopped. Choose a plan to resume — everything restarts on its own.

listing_not_selling.title: Listings that are not selling
listing_not_selling.description_one: {{count}} active listing has had no sale within the window you set. Review it and end it if it is not worth its place in your plan.
listing_not_selling.description_other: {{count}} active listings have had no sale within the window you set. Review them and end the ones that are not worth their place in your plan.

sourceUnavailable.unreadable: product data could not be read
